title: He Fought to Protect the Village - She Turned a Tiny Craft Stall Into Their Only Hope
genre: rural family drama set in a cold northern frontier settlement
premise: Isola (nickname Iso) has married Kalen, a centurion of the First Ranger Unit who guards the frontier settlement near the trade town Frostgate. She lifts the poor household with crafts (velvet flowers, hair ornaments), new foods and a secret knack for growing plants. The household: Kalen's mother Morgan (called Mom), his younger brother Ron and younger sister Ira. Ruby is Isola's pet red fox (animal, never speaks). Derek is Kalen's rival fighter; Derek's family (Serena) copies Isola's business.
